mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous week-over-week increases in PARKS and TRANSIT at t-0 signal a broad reopening of routine mobility, which raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the prior four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -18.7 to 5.1 and TRANSIT rose from -34.1 to -30.3 in t-0w
failure_condition: Next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to the last 28-day mean despite PARKS and TRANSIT both rising in t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS crossing above 0 percent change from baseline marks a shift from restricted to normal outdoor activity and spills over into retail-and-recreation footfall within two weeks, raising RETAIL_REC.

evidence_refs: fact:PARKS moved from -18.7 at t-1w to 5.1 at t-0w
